plan: Morten delves floor 2 under the Humans' A5, next door: XP toward level 4 at low risk (floor 3 lies past B4, an L10 hex).
He spends 62 GP 5 SP at the tower's trader (a Potion of Healing, incense for an owl, rations) and deposits the rest, 22 GP.
Tower: no action; 89 GP buys nothing, so it saves toward 200.
happened: Morten: Delve floor 1 under B5 (the dungeon game; no domain effect).
Tieflings (Exarch Iados, bad: squeezes its own people): Buy Treasury a26 in D5 (it has the gold), −1,200 GP → 300 GP.

Goblinkind (Big Boss Zarga, good: keeps the peace): Caravans a8 attacks Orcs' Thugs a2 in C2 → d10 1 + W3 + 1 claim = 5 vs d10 4 + W4 = 8, LOSS. Counter 1d4 3 = 3: Caravans 2 → 0 HP. Caravans a8 destroyed.
Tieflings (Exarch Iados, bad: squeezes its own people): goal done (buy Treasury (1,200 GP)): +1 XP (1).
Gnomes (Tinker-General Ellywick, bad: robs its neighbours): goal done (rob Tieflings' Mercenaries a16 in C5): +1 XP (1).
Elsewhere: Orcs bought Knights a27 in D1; Elves seized B1 (Orcs') (resolves at clean-up); Elves seized B1 (Orcs') (taken).
tower: HP 7/7 · Force 1 · Cunning 1 · Wealth 1 · 89 GP · Morten level 3
Assets: a25 the tower's Farms in B5 · T1 · HP 4/4 · no attack · counter 1d4
next: Chance: the Elves' seat A2 has no Force asset (Strike it for 2d6 to their HP 16/16).
Chance: the Gnomes' seat D3 has no Force asset (Strike it for 2d6 to their HP 22/22).
Open: Morten is in B5 (L1, desert, tower); travel 1 day a hex, d6 each day outside B5 (1 = encounter).

Open: the tower's one action (89 GP now): buy Thugs (200) · buy Militia (400) · buy Informers (200) · buy Smugglers (200) · buy Farms (200) · raise Force to 2 (200) · raise Cunning to 2 (200) · raise Wealth to 2 (200) · move · attack · seize · repair. Give is free.

words.force: Force: soldiers, and the strength to take and hold land.
words.cunning: Cunning: spies, informers and friends in the right places.
words.piece: A piece is something a realm has put on the map: soldiers, spies or income.
words.regime: The realm's health as a power; at 0 it falls.
words.level: Level N: floor N lies under it, its wanderers are level-N trouble, and it pays N×10 GP a month.
words.seat: The hex the ruler sits in; with no soldiers left there, the court itself fights.
words.hostile: A hostile realm spends its month punishing the tower, for 3 months (6 for a seat).
words.ally: An ally is a good ruler not hostile to the tower.
words.tier: Tier 1, 2 or 3: how big a fight it is when Morten goes after it (Low, Moderate, High).
words.occupied: A hex with another realm's soldiers in it pays its holder nothing.

Thugs.hits: hits with Force against Force for 1d3+1

Militia.hits: hits with Force against Force for 1d6

Beast pack.hits: hits with Force against Force for 2d4

Walls.special: can't move; +1 to its owner's defence in its hex; the hex can't be seized

Knights.hits: hits with Force against Force for 1d8

Warband.hits: hits with Force against Force for 2d8

Informers.what: eyes and ears in the hex
Informers.special: its owner sees every asset in its hex

Smugglers.hits: hits with Cunning against Wealth for 1d4

Saboteurs.hits: hits with Cunning against Cunning for 2d4

Seditionists.hits: hits with Cunning against Cunning for 1d6
Seditionists.special: coup: attacks the realm's HP from any of its hexes; bought only after a Contact; led by the dissident

Assassins.hits: hits with Cunning against Cunning for 2d6
Assassins.special: a win also does 1d4 to the target faction's HP

Court mage.hits: hits with Cunning against Cunning for 1d8
Court mage.special: once a month cancels an attack on its owner's asset in its hex (C vs C)

Caravans.hits: hits with Wealth against Wealth for 1d4

Mercenaries.hits: hits with Wealth against Force for 2d4+2

Treasury.special: income +100; a Rob here takes double

Toll road.hits: hits with Wealth against Wealth for 1d6
